title: The largest signed word of a table
task: count (a word, 1 to 16) words of table are signed numbers. Store the largest of them at big, then HLT. Keep the labels count, table and big and their DW lines: the tests write count and table and read big.
starter:
; largest -- practice exercise (MAVILERA, 8086)
; Store at big the largest signed word of table (count words).
; Hint: LODSW, CMP, a signed jump (JLE or JGE), LOOP.
        HLT                     ; replace with your code

count   DW   0                  ; the tests write the count here (1 to 16)
table   DW   16 DUP (0)         ; ... and the words here
big     DW   0                  ; your result
